MatrixState.title: MatrixState
MatrixState.description: Stores the current state of the 33-dimension BIM Maturity Matrix for Mesh Estudio.

selections.description: Map of the 33 BIM maturity dimension IDs to their selected level index (0 to 4).

scorePercentage.description: Computed overall BIM maturity percentage from 0 to 100.

maturityCategory.description: Classification label of the achieved BIM maturity level.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last save operation.

/matrices/{matrixId}.description: Singleton document (mesh_estudio) storing the BIM Maturity Matrix progress.
